result.title: DynOSeg: Dynamic Object Segmentation via Motion-Geometry Fusion
result.comment: Accepted at WACV 2027. 22 pages, including supplementary materials
result.summary: Moving Object Segmentation (MOS) detects and separates dynamic objects from the static background in a video, which plays a fundamental role in dynamic-scene understanding. Most MOS methods rely on pure visual motion cues alone, such as optical flow or point tracks, which is inherently ambiguous due to the compounded camera and object motions as well as motion-induced appearance changes, e.g. shadows and reflections. Naive fusion of additional information such as depth and semantics, however, cannot leverage their complementarity to the fullest extent. We therefore propose DynOSeg, a novel MOS approach that takes on a two-stage fusion structure. DynOSeg first combines a geometry-aware residual map and depth encoding into a geometric representation of motion, delineating camera motions and object dynamics. We then further incorporate semantic features to refine object understanding. We have additionally curated a diverse training corpus including CARLA-MOS, a new synthetic urban-driving dataset for MOS training. Our experiments show that DynOSeg consistently outperforms published state-of-the-art MOS methods across a diverse range of datasets. Our code and pretrained models can be found at https://github.com/ACFR-RPG/DynOSeg

AI.brief_summary: DynOSeg 提出两阶段融合的运动物体分割方法，先用几何感知残差图与深度编码刻画相机运动与物体动态，再引入语义特征细化物体理解，并构建了 CARLA-MOS 合成驾驶数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作针对视频中动态物体掩码分割的几何—语义融合，属自动驾驶感知任务，未涉及多模态推理状态、证据筛选或停止决策，与 LVR 主线缺乏可核查的具体联系。
